recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current core source and generated publication/download surfaces satisfy FHIR-32876 through the FHIR-31714/FHIR-28219 change family; revisit only if a future build regression expands clinical-patient.target beyond Patient again.
issue_request: FHIR-32876 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction reporting that the generated/downloaded SearchParameter/clinical-patient target list had expanded to all resource types even though related patient-search decisions required Patient only. Jira records the issue as a duplicate of FHIR-31714.
initial_application: FHIR-32876 itself has no direct source commit. The duplicate target FHIR-31714 was applied by a96b79e23a892164f261dcf4c7868ec1ef8023e2 and b9ee4c1747a9d505eec4b76c41e26d95c5dd6a30, which added explicit target declarations to constrained reference SearchParameters. The FHIR-32876 Jira comments later record that R4B and R5 showed target ["Patient"].
additional_context: FHIR-15903 and FHIR-28219 establish the same-change-family rule that patient search parameters should resolve only Patient, while broader Patient-or-Group references belong in subject or group parameters. FHIR-I minutes on 2021-12-20 treated FHIR-32876 as a duplicate of FHIR-31714 with no separate vote. Zulip and 2023 FHIR-I minutes noted possible generated-build regressions, but current source and current generated artifacts no longer show the erroneous target expansion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini; source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml does not assert Group or all-resource targets for clinical-patient; a full scan found no patient-code SearchParameter blocks with non-Patient target declarations; and build.fhir.org, R5, and R4B search-parameters.json all return target ["Patient"] for SearchParameter/clinical-patient.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-32876 was closed as a duplicate of FHIR-31714, whose resolution required target-constrained SearchParameter targets to be limited to Patient for clinical-patient.
Required common patient search parameters to use Patient-filtered expressions and a single Patient target.
Earlier published decision that patient search parameters should target Patient only, with subject parameters covering Patient-or-Group when needed.
Already represented on the combined branch with a no-change audit confirming the same patient-search target-scope family is correct in current source.
